title: Survival Starter Timeline
summary: A survival starter with weather checks, safety markers, reclamation goals, SoundCore ambience, and normal versus hardcore config guidance.
body: Use this card to connect the first 10 minutes, first 30 minutes, and first 2 hours for Survival generated packs.
steps: Open the survival guide in Index.
Find shelter and check the WeatherCore warning page.
Mark a safe zone on HoloMap.
Gather emergency food, light, and recovery supplies.
Start a first farm or reclamation patch.
commonMistakes: Story packs with no survival pressure
